name: run
arguments:
{"args":["-lc","cd /app && cp predictions.txt /tmp/pred.bak && cp model_comparison.csv /tmp/comp.bak && cp train_features.csv /tmp/tf.bak && cp train_response.csv /tmp/tr.bak && cp val_features.csv /tmp/vf.bak
fail=0
run_case() {
  desc="$1"; expect="$2"; shift 2
  rm -f /app/predictions.txt /app/model_comparison.csv
  out=$(python3 /app/compare_models.py 2>&1); code=$?
  if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then echo "FAIL(case $desc): exit 0, expected non-zero. out=$out"; fail=1;
  else echo "PASS(case $desc): exit $code. msg=$(echo "$out" | head -1)"; fi
  if [ -e /app/predictions.txt ] || [ -e /app/model_comparison.csv ]; then echo "FAIL(case $desc): output file written on failure"; fail=1; else echo "PASS(case $desc): no output files"; fi
}
# 1 missing file
mv /app/train_features.csv /tmp/tf.hide && run_case "missing-train-features" 1; mv /tmp/tf.hide /app/train_features.csv
# 2 empty file
: > /app/train_response.csv && run_case "empty-train-response" 1; cp /tmp/tr.bak /app/train_response.csv
# 3 non-numeric
cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv && echo "abc,def" >> /app/train_features.csv && run_case "non-numeric" 1; cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv
# 4 dimension mismatch (drop a response row)
head -60 /tmp/tr.bak > /app/train_response.csv && run_case "dim-mismatch" 1; cp /tmp/tr.bak /app/train_response.csv
# 5 all-zero features
python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('/tmp/tf.bak'); df[:]=0.0; df.to_csv('/app/train_features.csv',index=False)" && run_case "all-zero" 1; cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv
# 6 insufficient samples (1 row)
head -2 /tmp/tf.bak > /app/train_features.csv && head -2 /tmp/tr.bak > /app/train_response.csv && run_case "insufficient-samples" 1; cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv; cp /tmp/tr.bak /app/train_response.csv
# 7 inf values
python3 -c "import pandas as pd,numpy as np; df=pd.read_csv('/tmp/tf.bak'); df.iloc[0,0]=float('inf'); df.to_csv('/app/train_features.csv',index=False)" && run_case "infinite" 1; cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv
# restore success state
cp /tmp/tf.bak /app/train_features.csv; cp /tmp/tr.bak /app/train_response.csv; cp /tmp/vf.bak /app/val_features.csv
python3 /app/compare_models.py >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "REGEN_EXIT=$?"; wc -l /app/predictions.txt /app/model_comparison.csv
# verify restored outputs match backup
diff /tmp/pred.bak /app/predictions.txt && echo "predictions restored OK"
echo "OVERALL_FAIL=$fail""],"command":"bash"}
